products.name: NOIR
products.subtitle: Dark Woods, Black Pepper & Smoldering Incense
products.description: An enigmatic evening extrait juxtaposing sharp cracked black pepper and bitter cacao against a majestic foundation of charred oak, dark patchouli, and somber Omani frankincense.
products.imageAlt: VELORÉ NOIR luxury perfume flacon
products.seoDescription: Discover NOIR by VELORÉ. An enigmatic composition of dark woods, black pepper, and smoldering incense.

products.name: ÉLITE
products.subtitle: Aromatic French Lavender, Clary Sage & Vetiver
products.description: The epitome of sartorial refinement. Wild French high-altitude lavender married with aromatic clary sage, silver birch, and crisp Haitian vetiver, finished with warm roasted tonka bean.
products.imageAlt: VELORÉ ÉLITE luxury perfume bottle
products.seoDescription: ÉLITE by VELORÉ: Sophisticated French lavender, clary sage, and crisp vetiver.

products.name: LUMIÈRE
products.subtitle: Sparkling Calabrian Bergamot & Sheer White Florals
products.description: Sunlit optimism bottled at the Golden Hour. Crystalline Calabrian citrus and bitter orange blossom illuminate a transparent heart of royal jasmine, solar freesia, and velvety white cedar.
products.imageAlt: VELORÉ LUMIÈRE citrus and floral fragrance
products.seoDescription: LUMIÈRE by VELORÉ: Luminous Calabrian citrus and sheer white floral notes.

products.name: OUD 01
products.subtitle: Smoky Cambodi Oud, Damascena Rose & Birch Tar
products.description: Our signature opus. An opulent union of 25-year aged Cambodian agarwood, velvety Bulgarian damascena rose absolute, and smoky birch tar wrapped in golden amber and precious saffron.
products.imageAlt: VELORÉ OUD 01 Extrait de Parfum flacon
products.seoDescription: The iconic OUD 01 by VELORÉ. 25-year aged Cambodi agarwood and Bulgarian damascena rose.

products.name: VELVET ROSE
products.subtitle: Turkish Rose Absolute, Warm Praline & Clove
products.description: A decadent floral confection. Rich Turkish rose petals steeped in spiced clove, roasted caramelized praline, and warm golden ambergris for an irresistible, lingering embrace.
products.imageAlt: VELORÉ VELVET ROSE perfume bottle
products.seoTitle: VELVET ROSE Eau de Parfum — VELORÉ
products.seoDescription: VELVET ROSE by VELORÉ: Intoxicating Turkish rose absolute, warm praline, and spiced amber.

products.name: SANTAL
products.subtitle: Creamy Mysore Sandalwood, Cardamom & Violet Leaf
products.description: A temple of calm and contemplation. Ethically harvested Mysore sandalwood, green crushed cardamom pods, and tender violet leaves wrapped in dry Australian papyrus.
products.imageAlt: VELORÉ SANTAL sandalwood fragrance bottle
products.seoDescription: SANTAL by VELORÉ: Creamy Mysore sandalwood, aromatic cardamom, and violet leaf.

products.name: AURA
products.subtitle: Airy Solar Musks, Sparkling Aldehydes & White Tea
products.description: Pure radiance and ethereal lightness. Clean, crystalline aldehydes rise like morning mist over delicate white peony, Chinese white tea, and translucent, skin-soft solar musks.
products.imageAlt: VELORÉ AURA clean and airy fragrance bottle
products.seoDescription: AURA by VELORÉ: An ethereal, clean fragrance of solar musks and sparkling aldehydes.

products.name: AMBER 07
products.subtitle: Warm Benzoin, Resinous Labdanum & Spiced Clove
products.description: Seventh in our resinous master sequence. Rich, viscous Siamese benzoin and Spanish labdanum blended with crushed cinnamon bark, clove, and warm smoky ambergris.
products.imageAlt: VELORÉ AMBER 07 warm amber extrait flacon
products.seoDescription: AMBER 07 by VELORÉ: Opulent golden amber, Siamese benzoin, and warm spice.

products.name: BOIS BLANC
products.subtitle: White Cedar, Haitian Vetiver & Dry Birchwood
products.description: An architectural exploration of dry woods. Virginian white cedarwood and smokeless birch paired with mineral vetiver root, yielding a crisp, contemporary minimalist sillage.
products.imageAlt: VELORÉ BOIS BLANC white woods fragrance
products.seoTitle: BOIS BLANC Eau de Parfum — VELORÉ
products.seoDescription: BOIS BLANC by VELORÉ: Minimalist white cedar, Haitian vetiver, and dry birchwood.

products.name: VÉRITÉ
products.subtitle: Florentine Orris, Green Galbanum & Frankincense
products.description: Truth in raw formulation. Rare three-year-cured Florentine orris root butter paired with bitter Persian galbanum, fresh cardamom, and church incense, creating a noble powdered green trail.
products.imageAlt: VELORÉ VÉRITÉ pure orris extrait flacon
products.seoDescription: VÉRITÉ by VELORÉ: Masterful Florentine orris butter, green galbanum, and incense.

products.name: ÉCLAT
products.subtitle: Calabrian Bergamot, Neroli Petals & Clean Amber
products.description: The essence of Mediterranean light. Cold-pressed winter bergamot from Reggio Calabria blended with intoxicating Tunisian neroli petals, orange blossom, and sheer crystalline amber.
products.imageAlt: VELORÉ ÉCLAT citrus fragrance bottle
products.seoDescription: ÉCLAT by VELORÉ: Sparkling Calabrian bergamot and radiant Tunisian neroli petals.

products.name: NUIT
products.subtitle: Night-Blooming Jasmine, Incense & Dark Patchouli

products.seoDescription: NUIT by VELORÉ: Seductive night-blooming jasmine, incense, and dark patchouli.

products.name: MUSC BLANC
products.subtitle: Cotton Blossom, Heliotrope & Second-Skin Musks
products.description: The luxury of understated elegance. A skin-scent veil of sun-dried Egyptian cotton flower, powdery heliotrope, and gentle macrocyclic white musks that linger intimately on the collarbone.

products.seoTitle: MUSC BLANC Eau de Parfum — VELORÉ
products.seoDescription: MUSC BLANC by VELORÉ: Pure cotton blossom, heliotrope, and second-skin musks.

products.name: OUD ROYALE
products.subtitle: Aged Agarwood, Kashmiri Saffron & Golden Ambergris
products.description: The crown jewel of our vault. Hand-selected wild agarwood aged for three decades, enveloped in rare Kashmiri red saffron threads, rich Taif rose, and natural maritime ambergris.

products.seoTitle: OUD ROYALE Extrait de Parfum — VELORÉ
products.seoDescription: OUD ROYALE by VELORÉ: 30-year wild agarwood, Kashmiri saffron, and maritime ambergris.

products.name: ROSE ABSOLUE

products.seoTitle: ROSE ABSOLUE Eau de Parfum — VELORÉ
products.seoDescription: ROSE ABSOLUE by VELORÉ: Grasse centifolia rose, pink pepper, and clean patchouli blanc.

products.seoDescription: CÈDRE ÉLITE by VELORÉ: Himalayan cedarwood, aromatic juniper, and clary sage.

products.name: AMBRE NUIT
products.subtitle: Golden Labdanum, Bourbon Vanilla & Benzoin

products.seoDescription: AMBRE NUIT by VELORÉ: Resinous Spanish labdanum, cinnamon, and bourbon vanilla.

reviews.title: Intriguing Olfactory Depth
reviews.body: Sampled this fragrance at a private salon. Exceptional sillage with smoky vetiver nuances.

reviews.title: An undeniable masterpiece of olfactory depth
reviews.body: The opening of black amber and rare saffron immediately captivates. On the skin, the dry-down evolves into a smooth, velvety dark oud and leather that lingers for well over fourteen hours. Unquestionably my signature evening flacon.

reviews.title: Opulent, mysterious and flawlessly blended
reviews.body: Veloré Noir represents what contemporary high perfumery should be. The sillage is dignified without being aggressive, leaving an enchanting trail of smoked incense and bourbon vanilla. The flacon presentation is stunning.

reviews.title: Golden Mediterranean sunlight captured in crystal
reviews.body: The neroli and Calabrian bergamot radiate with pure elegance. It transitions seamlessly into creamy solar jasmine and warm golden cedar. Perfect for daytime salons and warm European evenings.

reviews.title: Precious royal Cambodian oud of the highest calibre
reviews.body: Having collected rare vintage ouds for over two decades, I was astonished by the purity and resinous complexity of this extraction. Rich, smoky, and devoid of any medicinal harshness. Worth every sovereign.

reviews.title: Remarkable longevity and refined iris nuance
reviews.body: A very regal and powdery iris accord wrapped in blonde woods. Takes about twenty minutes to truly settle on the pulse points, after which the cedar and white musk project effortlessly.
